// @version=5
indicator("Lucid 7 — Eval Sprint", overlay=true, max_labels_count=500, max_lines_count=500)

// Evaluation sprint: one NQ trade a day at the close of the first RTH
// minute (09:30-09:31 ET), target +0.20% of price, stop -0.40%, otherwise
// flat at 15:55. Size so the stop costs at most "Max loss"; with $1,900 that
// is a ~$950-1,000 win, so three winning days reach +$3,000 with the best day
// about a third of the profit (50% consistency rule). One losing day ends the
// attempt. NQ 2018-2025 with costs: ~35% of attempts pass, ~5 trading days
// per attempt. Use a 1-minute MNQ chart.
// Bias "Auto": long when NQ's prior daily close is above its 50-day average,
// short when below. Tested 2018-2025: pass per attempt 39% vs 36% always long,
// in both 2018-21 and 2022-25 (a small but consistent gain).

maxLoss  = input.float(1900.0, "Max loss per trade ($)")
tgtPct   = input.float(0.20, "Target (% of price)") / 100.0
stpPct   = input.float(0.40, "Stop (% of price)") / 100.0
ptValue  = input.float(2.0, "$ per point per contract (MNQ = 2)")
maxCts   = input.int(40, "Max contracts")
biasMode = input.string("Auto (50-day trend)", "Bias", options=["Auto (50-day trend)", "Long", "Short"])
useVol   = input.bool(true, "Volatility gate (skip if NQ 20d vol >= 30%)")
volSym   = input.string("CME_MINI:NQ1!", "   vol gate symbol")
// Daily values: last COMPLETED session ([1] + lookahead_on), identical in history and
// real time (lookahead_off would use the forming daily bar live). Fixed 2026-10-23.

rvol20 = request.security(volSym, "D", (ta.stdev(close / close[1] - 1.0, 20) * math.sqrt(252))[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
volOK = not useVol or na(rvol20) or rvol20 < 0.30
dClose = request.security(volSym, "D", (close)[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
dSma50 = request.security(volSym, "D", (ta.sma(close, 50))[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
bias = biasMode == "Long" ? 1 : biasMode == "Short" ? -1 : (dClose > dSma50 ? 1 : -1)

oMin = hour(time, "America/New_York") * 60 + minute(time, "America/New_York")
cMin = hour(time_close, "America/New_York") * 60 + minute(time_close, "America/New_York")
is1 = timeframe.period == "1"

var float e = na
var float tp = na
var float sl = na
var int cts = 0
var int dir = 0
var line eL = na
var line tL = na
var line sL = na

// entry at the close of the 09:30 bar
if is1 and oMin == 570 and barstate.isconfirmed and na(e) and volOK
    dir := bias
    e := close
    tp := close * (1.0 + dir * tgtPct)
    sl := close * (1.0 - dir * stpPct)
    cts := math.min(maxCts, math.max(1, int(math.floor(maxLoss / (math.abs(e - sl) * ptValue)))))
    eL := line.new(bar_index, e, bar_index + 30, e, color=color.yellow, width=2, extend=extend.right)
    tL := line.new(bar_index, tp, bar_index + 30, tp, color=color.lime, width=2, extend=extend.right)
    sL := line.new(bar_index, sl, bar_index + 30, sl, color=color.red, width=2, extend=extend.right)
    label.new(bar_index, dir == 1 ? low : high, "SPRINT " + (dir == 1 ? "LONG " : "SHORT ") + str.tostring(cts) + " MNQ\nwin $" + str.tostring(cts * math.abs(tp - e) * ptValue, "#") + " / loss $" + str.tostring(cts * math.abs(e - sl) * ptValue, "#"), color=dir == 1 ? color.blue : color.purple, textcolor=color.white, style=dir == 1 ? label.style_label_up : label.style_label_down, size=size.normal)

// exits from the next bar on; a bar touching both counts as the stop
if not na(e) and not (oMin == 570)
    rsn = ""
    px = 0.0
    if (dir == 1 and low <= sl) or (dir == -1 and high >= sl)
        rsn := "LOSS"
        px := dir == 1 ? math.min(sl, open) : math.max(sl, open)
    else if (dir == 1 and high >= tp) or (dir == -1 and low <= tp)
        rsn := "WIN"
        px := dir == 1 ? math.max(tp, open) : math.min(tp, open)
    else if cMin >= 955
        rsn := "EOD"
        px := close
    if rsn != ""
        usd = cts * dir * (px - e) * ptValue
        line.set_x2(eL, bar_index)
        line.set_x2(tL, bar_index)
        line.set_x2(sL, bar_index)
        line.set_extend(eL, extend.none)
        line.set_extend(tL, extend.none)
        line.set_extend(sL, extend.none)
        label.new(bar_index, px, "SPRINT " + rsn + "\n" + (usd >= 0 ? "+$" : "-$") + str.tostring(math.abs(usd), "#"), color=usd >= 0 ? color.green : color.red, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.small)
        e := na

var table tb = table.new(position.top_right, 1, 1, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30))
if barstate.islast
    msg = not is1 ? "EVAL SPRINT: use a 1-minute chart" : not volOK ? "VOL TOO HIGH — no sprint today" : not na(e) ? "IN TRADE: " + (dir == 1 ? "LONG " : "SHORT ") + str.tostring(cts) + " MNQ  TP " + str.tostring(tp, format.mintick) + "  SL " + str.tostring(sl, format.mintick) : "next: " + (bias == 1 ? "LONG" : "SHORT") + " at the close of the 09:30 bar"
    table.cell(tb, 0, 0, msg, text_color=color.white, bgcolor=not is1 or not volOK ? color.red : not na(e) ? color.new(color.orange, 20) : color.new(color.gray, 50))
